name: statmine
description: A statusline that shows where a commit will land, your context use, and your last three requests, in a full or compact view.

label.title: Header label
label.description: Text at the start of the statusline. Leave empty for none.

summaries.title: Summarize long requests
summaries.description: Ask a small model for a one-line summary of prompts too long for a row. Each long prompt costs one model call on your own Claude account.

summary_model.title: Summary model
summary_model.description: Model for summaries, as passed to claude --model.
